P7478.corridor_notes: Per Yunnan Housing & Urban-Rural Development Dept. siting-notice text (via Sohu, dated 2016-06-14): '该项目起于昆明富民县赤鹫镇中缅天然气管道24#阀室，止点位于五华区桃园小村西侧的桃园末站' — the Fumin branch of the Yunnan gas trunk network starts at China-Myanmar pipeline Valve Station #24 in Chijiu Town, Fumin County, and ends at Taoyuan Terminal Station west of Taoyuan hamlet, Wuhua District, Kunming. Cited length 56.9 km (47.1 km in Fumin County + 9.8 km in Wuhua District) is close to GEM's 58.00 km (2016 siting-stage estimate vs. as-built; both describe the same two endpoints and the same Fumin→Wuhua corridor). This is a distinct project from the separately-documented 'Fumin–Changshui' branch (105.64 km, to Changshui Airport, a different terminus) surfaced in the same search — do not conflate the two; GEM's SegmentName/Start-EndLocation match the Taoyuan-terminus project, not the airport one.
P7478.researcher_notes: GEM StartLocation 'Fumin County' and EndLocation 'Wuhua District' both confirmed and refined to named places (Chijiu Town / Taoyuan hamlet) via the 2016 siting-notice republication on Sohu (original Yunnan Provincial Dept. of Housing & Urban-Rural Development notice, no longer live at its original .gov.cn URL). Two other Fumin-adjacent gas projects exist in the record and were ruled out as this PID: (1) 'Fumin–Changshui' (富民—长水), 105.64 km, ending at Changshui Airport (a different, larger branch); (2) a short 13.42 km 'Valve Station 24#—Fumin distribution station' spur approved 2025-04-30 (fgw.km.gov.cn) that appears to be a later, separate feeder within Fumin County itself, not reaching Wuhua District. Confidence tier: single-source (one original document, one republication host) — corroborating second source not found in this pass.
P7478.blockers: Only one primary source located (a 2016 siting-notice republished on Sohu); the original .gov.cn siting-notice page is no longer live and no second independent source with the same Chijiu→Taoyuan endpoint pair was found. Exact coordinates for Taoyuan hamlet itself (vs. the subdistrict centroid used) not resolvable in OSM/Nominatim.
